selection_rule: Union of (a) npm stdio packages listed in the official MCP Registry (latest versions) and (b) npm search results for keywords mcp-server / mcp / modelcontextprotocol and the free text 'mcp server'. A candidate is kept if its latest version declares a `bin` and (is registry-listed OR depends on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk or @modelcontextprotocol/server OR has keyword `mcp-server`), its name does not match the library pattern (sdk|client|types|framework|inspector|proxy|gateway|bridge|cli-core), and it is not in exclusions.yaml. Ranked by npm weekly downloads; top N kept.
